name: GlareHover
description: A band of light that sweeps across a card or an image when the pointer or keyboard focus reaches it.

angle.description: Tilt of the band in degrees.

color.description: Colour of the glare, any CSS colour. Defaults to a soft tint of the action colour, which shows on light and dark surfaces. Use white at low strength on a dark card.

isPaused.description: Stops the effect and shows it still.

requirements: The glare is decoration: aria-hidden and never blocks the pointer
It sweeps once on hover and once on focus-within, so keyboard users see the same effect, and it is not a way to show state
Off for reduced motion, inside rdm-still and with isPaused
The glare is a faint tint, so the text or image underneath keeps its contrast
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the band is removed
screenReader: Read as ordinary content: the glare is not announced

use_when: A hover accent on a photo
avoid_when: Text the reader must keep reading while the band crosses it
anti_patterns: Using the glare as the only sign that something is clickable
